title: Perform screed maintenance
intro: Screed maintenance protects plate condition, movement and the quality of the next mat. Use the fitted screed’s service instructions and coordinate shared systems with the paver operator.

sections.title: Service lubrication system (greasing)
sections.text: Identify lubrication points, including thickness-control screws and extension mechanisms where specified. Confirm lubricant, interval, quantity and safe position. Clean fittings and load the grease gun correctly. Centralized systems and optional fittings change the route; do not assume grease at one point reaches every component. Report damaged fittings and protect the work area from excess lubricant.

sections.title: Inspect and clean components as required
sections.text: Inspect accessible components and the paver systems serving the screed, including hydraulic lines, electrical/heating connections and cooling systems where applicable. Radiator, oil-cooler, battery, plug and dipstick checks may belong to the shared tractor maintenance schedule rather than a separate screed engine. Identify what is actually fitted. Use isolation, cooling and approved access; do not open hot pressure systems or diagnose electrical faults beyond authorization.

sections.title: Perform housekeeping tasks
sections.text: Remove rubbish, buildup and excess grease from safe access surfaces, controls, steps, decks and any fitted cab/windows. Use compatible products and contain waste. Coordinate cleaning with the paver crew so no one restarts or moves a shared system unexpectedly. Restore guards and account for tools.

sections.title: Maintain screed plate
sections.text: Inspect the screed plate and extension plates for wear, damage, distortion and buildup. Check adjustment and replacement criteria in the actual manual. A scuff or streak in the mat can indicate a plate/setup/material problem; record the pattern and investigate rather than assuming more heat will fix it. Plate replacement and alignment require authorized procedures, support and specified fasteners/settings. Record the condition before and after service.

worked.title: A recurring streak
worked.case: A streak returns along the same line after surface buildup is removed.
worked.solution: Record its position and persistence. Have authorized personnel inspect plate wear/flatness, extension alignment, heating and relevant setup under safe conditions. Do not continue scraping a moving or hot hazard area or guess a replacement tolerance.

activities.prompt: A fictional wear check shows 8.0 mm initially and 6.5 mm now. Find the loss. Does that establish replacement?
activities.answer: Loss = 1.5 mm. Replacement depends on the actual manufacturer’s limit, measurement method and condition; the arithmetic alone is insufficient.

activities.prompt: Identify which maintenance items belong to the actual screed and which to shared tractor systems.
activities.answer: Use the model diagram and schedule. Screed plates, extensions and thickness screws are screed items; engine radiator/battery may be shared tractor items. Record fitted options and do not invent absent components.

activities.prompt: Draft a safe cleaning handover between two operators.
activities.answer: State machine/screed, isolated functions, heat condition, cleaning area/product, people involved, required supports and the person coordinating reinstatement after tools/guards are checked.
activities.title: Draft a safe cleaning handover between two operators.

practical: Service actual lubrication points and shared systems safely.
Inspect plate condition against manufacturer criteria.
Clean, restore guards and complete a service/defect record.
